info.title: Paint Shop Platform API
info.description: Backend API for the Paint Shop SaaS Platform. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json).

platformRole.description: Null unless the caller is a platform admin.

shopMemberships.description: Shops the caller belongs to, most recent first.

q.description: Shop name, owner name or owner mobile.

statusCounts.description: Shops per status for the current search.

photoThumbUrl.description: The public shop photo, if any.

phone.description: E.164 mobile number of the master account.

updatedAt.description: When the profile was last changed.

supportPhone.description: Customer-support mobile (Indian). Null clears it. Stored as E.164.

address.description: The full address, or null to clear it.

location.description: Omit to keep the current location.

progress.description: Counted items, for example active products with a pack size.

packs.description: Replaces the pack sizes. A pack used by a shop listing cannot be removed (409 pack_in_use).

applied.description: False for a dry run or when any row has an error.

errors.description: Row 1 is the first data row. At most 100 are listed.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

brand.description: id is null for a typed brand name.

catalogueActive.description: False when the platform archived the catalogue product, brand or category; always true for own products.

unlistedCataloguePacks.description: Catalogue pack sizes the shop does not sell yet.

size.description: Products that have this pack size.

show.description: available: every size available; partly: some not available; none: no size available.

packs.description: Pack sizes in the current tab, smallest first.

options.description: Filter values that exist in this shop for the current tab and status.

brandId.description: A brand from the brand catalogue.

brandName.description: A brand that is not in the brand catalogue.

mrpPaise.description: Maximum retail price in paise; optional.
Maximum retail price in paise; optional.
Maximum retail price in paise; optional.

brandId.description: Leave out to search every brand (needs q).

listedProductId.description: The shop's listing of this product, if any.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

own.description: True for the shop's own category, false for a platform one.

productCount.description: The shop's products in this category (all statuses).

missing.description: Checklist items still to do; empty when complete.

canSubmit.description: The checklist is complete and the shop is a draft or has changes requested.

open.description: The submission waiting for review, if any.

lastDecision.description: The latest approval or change request.

q.description: Shop name, owner name or owner mobile.

sort.description: Oldest first is fair: shops wait the least.

resubmission.description: Submitted again after a change request.

note.description: Shown to the owner. Required with OTHER.

status.description: open: new, packing, ready for pickup and out for delivery. ready: ready for pickup and out for delivery.

q.description: Order number, customer name or mobile number.
